name: skill-incubator
description: An installable experimentation ground for skills that have not yet formed an independent plugin boundary.

interface.shortDescription: Installable experimentation ground for evolving skills
interface.longDescription: Skill Incubator packages evolving skills for normal installation, invocation, and release while their long-term plugin boundary remains a maintainer decision. It currently covers physics-manuscript polishing, presentations, reviewer responses, scholarly evaluation, and an explicit-only knowledge-distillation entry point.
defaultPrompt: Use paper2ppt to turn this scientific paper into presentation-ready source material
Use ppt-master to create, fill, or enhance an editable PowerPoint presentation
Use prl-polishing to review and revise this physics manuscript paragraph by paragraph
Use the appropriate incubating skill to evaluate research or prepare a reviewer response
